name: 4NE1 Mini
summary: NEURA Robotics' compact humanoid, offered in Standard and Pro configurations. Reservations place customers in NEURA's delivery queue, with both expected in 2026. NEURA's own price estimates are €19,999 (Standard) and €29,999 (Pro), excluding taxes and shipping. Pro lists 12 DoF dexterous hands; Standard lists manipulation as not included.
specs_note: RETRIEVAL: AGENT_ASSISTED_RESEARCH (docs/26) — retrieved 2026-10-04 by Claude (curl; PDF sha256 1e8d135d28d2f0e0d55496aca93f66793f83bf63f2438045170a12d349e12087) in a session initiated by Robert Konecny, under his instruction 'Start with the 4NE1 Mini datasheet extraction' (2026-10-04). Not a MANUAL_BOOTSTRAP reading; not human-verified. Source: NEURA Robotics '4NE1 Mini' datasheet (https://neurarobotics.px.media/plk/Jj/4NE1Minidatasheet.pdf; 2 pages; 'All rights reserved V1 / 01.01.2026'). Values as stated: Height 132 cm (4'4"); Weight 36 kg (79 lbs); Payload 3 kg (6.6 lbs), not stated per arm or in total; DoF 25, base unit only, excluding hands and end effectors (which 'may each have up to 12 DoF independently'); Motion Endurance 2.5 h recorded as runtime_minutes 150 (a unit conversion of the stated endurance). 'Operating Time (h) 24/7' and 'Speed Max. 4.6 km/h (2.9 mph)' are kept verbatim as long-tail specifications and NOT mapped to runtime or walk speed: the sheet does not say walking speed or what 24/7 operation requires. Deliberately not derived: has_manipulation and hand_dof (owner rulings of 2026-10-03), has_vision, has_language_ui. The sheet says delivery 'in Spring 2026'; the stored availability remains the product page's 'Expected in 2026' and is not changed here. The sheet's family-level interfaces ('Wi-Fi 6, Gigabit Ethernet, ROS2, C++ & Python SDK, NeuraSync') do not replace the variant-scoped interface specifications.
